v: pu॰ dundu ityavyaktaSabdenoBati pUrayati uBa--pUraRe ki Saka॰ । vfhaqQakkAyAm amaraH । “dunduBe! tvaM sapatnAnAM TozAd hfdayakampanaH” dunduBipUjAmantraH “vijaya dunduBitAmayurarRavAH” raGuH “dunduBiSca tadA devEstAqito devakiNkarEH” BA॰ anu॰ 26 Slo॰ । 1 varuRe 2 dEtyaBede medi॰ 3 rAkzasaBede pu॰ Sabdara॰ 4 vize hemaca॰ 5 pASake strI amaraH svarRaSfNgAdimaye catuHpArSvo vinduyukte dyUtoprakaraRe (pASawI) KyAte 6 padArTe strI 7 ganDarvIBede strI vA NIz । “tezAM samakzaM ganDarvI dundurBIM nAma nAmataH । SaSAsa varadodevo gacCa kAryArTasidDaye । pitAmahavacaH SrutvA ganDarvI dunduBI tataH । manTarA mAnuze loke kubjAnAmABavattadA” BA॰ va॰ 375 a॰ dunduBirnAmAsuraBedaSca mAyAvinAmAsurapitA tatkaTA rAmA॰ ki॰ 9 sarge “mAyAvI nAma tejasvI pUrvajo dunduBeH sutaH । tena tasya mahadvEraM bAlinaH strIkftaM purA” “yadA tu dunduBiM nAma dAnavaM mahizAkftim । pratikAlayate bAlI malayaM pratiparbatam । tadA viveSa mahizo malayasya guhAM prati । viveSa bAlI tatrApi malayaM tajjiGAMsayA” rAmA॰ ki॰ 46 a॰ 4 Slo॰ । “dunduBiM nAmeti atra dunduBiSabdena tatputro mAyAvinAmA dAnava ucyate tadvfttAntasyEvAgre vakzyamARa tvAt “mAyAvI nAma tejasvI dundaBeH pUrvajaH sutaH” iti proktestasya tat putratvaM piturmahizAkAratvAt tatputrasya tadAkAratvamiti ca voDyam” tawwIkA

स्याद्भेर्यां दुन्दुभिः पुंसि स्यादक्षे दुन्दुभिः स्त्रियाम्. स्यान्महारजते क्लीबं कुसुम्भं करके पुमान्.।
